name: spreadsheetSetColumnHidden
description: Shows or hides a column of the active sheet in a spreadsheet workbook. Columns are 1-based. The fluent member form is setColumnHidden(column, hidden), with the shorthand members hideColumn(column) and showColumn(column) and the predicate isColumnHidden(column).

params.name: hidden
params.description: True to hide the column, false to show it (default true).

examples.title: Hide the helper column
examples.description: Hide column 3 and check its hidden state.
